html:
If you are staying in Da Nang and looking for a comfortable and flexible way to visit My Son Sanctuary, Vietlook Travel offers a round-trip private car service from Da Nang to My Son with an experienced local driver.

My Son Sanctuary is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the most important cultural and historical destinations in central Vietnam. Traveling by private car allows you to enjoy the journey at your own pace while avoiding the limitations of group tours.

Da Nang to My Son Distance and Travel Time

The distance from Da Nang city center to My Son Sanctuary is approximately forty kilometers one way. The transfer by private car takes about one hour to one hour and fifteen minutes, depending on traffic conditions.

With a private car, you can choose your preferred departure time and enjoy a direct, door-to-door service without waiting for other passengers.

Flexible Private Car Service

By booking a Da Nang to My Son private car with Vietlook Travel, you will enjoy:

  • Full flexibility in departure time

  • Door-to-door pick-up and drop-off at your hotel

  • Privacy and comfort during the journey

  • Freedom to stop for photos, rest breaks, or refreshments

Our experienced drivers are familiar with the route and will ensure a safe and smooth transfer.

About My Son Sanctuary

My Son Sanctuary was the religious and political center of the ancient Champa Kingdom from the fourth to the thirteenth century. The complex includes a group of Hindu temples and towers set in a lush valley surrounded by mountains.

Visitors can explore:

  • Ancient Cham temple ruins

  • Historical architecture and carvings

  • Peaceful natural surroundings

You may spend as much time as you wish at the site, depending on your schedule.

Professional Driver and Comfortable Vehicles

Vietlook Travel provides:

  • Modern, clean, and well maintained vehicles

  • Strong air conditioning and safety seat belts

  • Polite and knowledgeable drivers

  • Free baby seat available upon request

Vehicle options include sedan cars, sport utility vehicles, minivans, and luxury vehicles.
